title: Generate downloadable product files (PDF + assets) for three AI-automation products

requirements.text: Create a frontend workflow to define and manage three digital product entries (title, subtitle, description, included modules/chapters, prompts/templates/checklists, and optional branding fields), with an editor UI that supports saving drafts locally and regenerating outputs on demand.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit exactly three product entries in the UI (with clear labels and validation).
Edits persist across page refresh (local persistence is acceptable).
User can trigger generation for an individual product or for all three products.

requirements.text: Generate complete product files for each of the three products as downloadable assets, including at minimum: (1) a multi-page PDF document and (2) a structured bundle of supplementary files (e.g., TXT/MD templates, checklists, prompt packs) packaged into a single ZIP per product.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: For each product, the app produces a downloadable PDF file generated from the product’s current content.
For each product, the app produces a downloadable ZIP containing the PDF plus supplementary files in a clear folder structure.
Generated filenames are deterministic and safe (no illegal characters), and include product name + version/date.
All downloads work in a standard modern browser without requiring external services.

requirements.text: Provide a “Gumroad/Etsy export” screen that summarizes the generated deliverables for each product (what’s included, file sizes, and a preview thumbnail), and offers one-click download per product plus a “Download all products” option that creates a single ZIP containing all three product ZIPs.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: Export screen lists three products with: included files list, last-generated timestamp, and download buttons.
User can download an all-products bundle as a single ZIP.
If a product has not been generated yet, the UI clearly indicates this and disables downloads until generation is run.

requirements.text: Add a lightweight backend canister API to store/retrieve product definitions and generation metadata (e.g., last generated time, version tag) so the app can persist product content beyond the browser and support multi-device use with Internet Identity login.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can save and reload their three product definitions from the backend.
Backend enforces that each user only accesses their own product data.
App continues to function in a limited mode when not authenticated (e.g., local-only drafts), with a clear prompt to sign in to sync.

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, distinctive visual theme across the app (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) appropriate for a “digital product generator” tool, and keep all user-facing text in English.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: UI has a consistent look and feel across editor, preview, and export screens.
No user-facing strings appear in languages other than English.
Theme avoids default/unstyled appearance and uses Tailwind + existing UI components via composition (no edits to immutable UI component sources).

requirements.text: Add in-app previews: a quick PDF preview (first pages or a rendered preview panel) and a ZIP content preview (tree/list of files that will be included) before downloading.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: User can preview key sections/pages before download for each product.
User can view the list of files/folders that will be included in each ZIP prior to generation/download.
Preview updates after regeneration.

requirements.text: Include static generated brand/cover imagery for the three products (one cover image per product) as part of the downloadable bundle, and render these images in the UI as preview thumbnails.

quotes: Yes, please create the product files

acceptanceCriteria: Each product includes a cover image file in its ZIP bundle.
Export screen shows a thumbnail preview for each product cover image.
Cover images are served as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated (not through the backend).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in the main actor).
Do not modify files under frontend immutablePaths; compose existing UI components instead.
Do not rely on external databases or third-party auth providers; use Internet Identity for authentication.
nonGoals: Integrations with Gumroad/Etsy APIs (auto-upload, listing creation, pricing, etc.).
Real-time collaboration, chat, or multi-user shared workspaces.
Email delivery of files or external cloud storage exports.

required: Minimalist abstract tech cover with clean geometric shapes, high-contrast warm palette (product-cover-1.dim_1600x2560.png)
Minimalist abstract workflow/automation cover with modern typography-friendly negative space, muted earthy palette (product-cover-2.dim_1600x2560.png)
Minimalist abstract AI/prompting cover with subtle grid pattern and soft gradient, neutral palette (product-cover-3.dim_1600x2560.png)
